Name: AhCuteArt's Ultimate Vanilla Fence Edits
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[b][size=5][center]AhCuteArt's Colored Theme Project[/center]
[/size][/b]

Hi, hi! This is another one of my entries for the 2026 SDVModfest. I know I usually make Nyapu mod retextures, but I want to create mods with my own art for the contest. I'll get back to retexturing more Nyapu portraits as soon as the contest is over (or I burn myself out making these colored themed mods, LOL.) 

Here is a fence mod I've been slowly working on for a while. The contest inspired me to finish it. I always thought the vanilla fences in my mod were too plain and any of the other mods out there had stunning retextures, but nothing that would fit with some of the color themes I play with. So I decided to create my own mod. I edited several aspects of the base vanilla gates and added my own adjustments. I also created my own gates since I didn't care for the originals. Unfortunately, the side-facing gates had to be thinner because the tile sheet limits the size of those gates. I swear, I added so many gates and fences that I will be seeing pixel art and code in my sleep for a while. 

Lastly, I added festival decorations to my fences. I've always wanted to decorate my farm for every holiday... but that would be a pain to put up and take down. But this isn't an issue any longer! Now the gates will automatically be decorated for every holiday. If you don't like that option, it can easily be removed in GMCM. 



[b]Current Colors: Black, Blue, Red, White, Green, Grey, Orange, Purple, Yellow,  Baby Blue, Buttermilk, Lilac, Marigold, Mint, and Pink
[b]Gate Types: Vanilla Wood, Vanilla Iron, Vanilla Hardwood, Vanilla Stone, New Wood, New Iron, New Hardwood, New Stone[/b]
[/b][b]
[/b]
[b][size=4]INSTALLATION (Must have Content Patcher): [/size]
[/b]
1. ﻿Choose one of the files or both. (Both the CP and AT files work together or separately) 
2. ﻿Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder

[b]
[size=4]There are Two files:[/size][/b]
[CP File] This file will change all vanilla fences and gates into a themed type and color. Go into the GMCM and look for [b](CP) AhCuteArt Ultimate Vanilla Fence Edits[/b] to change the color and gate type options you want. Festival decor is only found in this file. 

[AT File] This file will change fences and gates into whatever theme and color you want. Make sure to buy the paint bucket from Robin to be able to edit your fences and gates. Only the new gate designs are available. (It would have been too much for me to code in the vanilla colored gates as well.) 

[b][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]This should work in every language. (I hope)
[*]The CP file might clash with other mods that edit fences and gates, but the AT file will work with anything. 
[/list][b][size=4]
EXTRA!:[/size][/b]
During the major holidays, little dark fairies will decorate your gates and fences for the Flower, Desert, Egg, Luau,Trout Derby, Midnight Jellies, Fair, Spirit, Ice, Squidfest, Night Market, and Star Festivals. (This can be shut off in the GMCM menu)

[b][size=4]Future Plans:[/size][/b]
I am working on adding the SVE fences to this mod eventually.

[/b][i]If there is a color you want or a theme you would like to see done, feel free to request it, and I'll add it when I get the time.  [/i][/i]
